name: --moe-cpu-threads
note: doc 18 phase 1: coordinator and spin threads share 8 cores

name: FT_P4_FUSED_COMBINE
note: bit-exact standalone, checked on Groot only (doc 18); not committed

name: --moe-hybrid-max-fetch
note: 2026-11-12: fixed caps against auto (-1, from the ft bench bw profile; 0 = every miss on the CPU). Values are a first pick, not from the code.

name: --moe-locked-max-fetch
note: 2026-11-12: default 8; applies only to layers left locked by --moe-cpu-layers auto; costs pinned staging per bank

name: --max-prefill-length
note: 2026-11-12: default chunk is 8192 (scheduler config); judged on 5K-prompt prefill speed

name: --moe-cache-scope
note: 2026-11-12: one slot pool per layer (equal split) against the unified pool

name: --moe-prefill-hit-d2d
note: 2026-11-12: not run: with --moe-cpu-layers auto and locked layers the engine forces prefill overlap off, so this does nothing (engine.py:1035). Try only on a model with no locked layers; the log says 'hit-D2D requested but unavailable' if HIP batch copy fails.

name: --disable-moe-prefill-overlap
note: 2026-11-12: not run: overlap is already off under split residency (see prefill-hit-d2d)

name: --moe-cache-split
note: 2026-11-12: needs --moe-cache-scope per-layer and a profile file {model, expert_counts[L][E]}; no tool writes one yet (FT_EXPERT_FREQ's decode matrix could be wrapped). Expert skew measured weak on the 35B, so low priority.

name: --kv-cache-dtype
note: 2026-11-13 (upstream #894): 8-bit KV, about half the KV memory, so more context per GB. Lossy, so never auto-kept. Needs --dtype bfloat16; never loaded on ROCm. int8_per_token_head is the other format.

name: --speculative-token-map
note: 2026-11-13 (upstream #892): MTP draft scores only the ids in a map file; target still verifies the whole vocabulary. Needs a file from scripts/make_token_map.py MODEL (tokenizer only) and belongs in the spec stage (MTP on), not here.

name: --online-quant
note: 2026-11-13 (upstream #891): lossless ~11 bit packing of bf16 layers only, about 30% less VRAM for those, a decode per use. A GGUF-quantized model like the 35B IQ4_NL has few or no bf16 Linear layers, so probably refused there.
